# flowbite-xor

> Flowbite v4 and Tailwind CSS v4 components, layouts, blocks and a form theme for Symfony UX, with all behavior in Stimulus controllers so they keep working under Turbo and Live Components.

A Symfony UX Toolkit kit: install a recipe with `php bin/console ux:install <recipe> --kit=https://github.com/xormania/flowbite-xor`, which copies its files into the project. Each recipe's README gives its props, examples and how it behaves in forms, Live Components and Turbo Frames.

## Start here

- [For agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/FOR-AGENTS.md): what the kit gives you, how to set a project up, which recipe to install for what, and the rules to follow
- [Project agents snippet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/docs/PROJECT-AGENTS-SNIPPET.md): the block to paste into a project's AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md
- [Install](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/INSTALL.md): each setup step explained, AssetMapper or Webpack Encore
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/README.md): every recipe, updating, Turbo and Live Components, security, versions and requirements

## Theme

- [theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/theme/README.md): Flowbite's color roles, with this kit's contrast fixes, as one stylesheet to import in `assets/styles/app.css`. A role is a named color with a light and a dark value, used as a utility: `bg-brand`, `text-heading`, `border-default`.
- [theme-toggle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/theme-toggle/README.md): A button switching between the light and dark themes, remembered in `localStorage` and following the system preference until the user chooses.

## Basic components

- [alert](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/alert/README.md): A message for information, success, a warning or an error, optionally dismissible.
- [avatar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/avatar/README.md): A user's picture, with a fallback, in several sizes, round or with rounded corners.
- [badge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/badge/README.md): A small label or count next to other content, such as a number of comments.
- [button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/button/README.md): A button, or a link that looks like one, in several colors, sizes and styles.
- [button-group](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/button-group/README.md): Several buttons or links joined into one control.
- [card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/card/README.md): A box grouping related content: text, images, a form.
- [checkbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/checkbox/README.md): A square box to select one or more options.
- [dropdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/dropdown/README.md): A menu that opens from a button and closes when the user clicks or focuses outside it.
- [indicator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/indicator/README.md): A dot or number placed on another element: a status, a count, a loading label.
- [input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/input/README.md): A single-line field for any input type: text, email, number, password, URL…
- [kbd](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/kbd/README.md): A keyboard key or shortcut shown in text.
- [label](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/label/README.md): A text element that identifies form controls and other content.
- [modal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/modal/README.md): A dialog over the page, as a native `<dialog>`, with a close button.
- [pagination](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/pagination/README.md): Links to the pages of a long list.
- [radio](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/radio/README.md): A round button to choose one option among several.
- [select](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/select/README.md): A list to choose one or more options.
- [skeleton](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/skeleton/README.md): Placeholders shaped like the content that is loading.
- [spinner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/spinner/README.md): A spinning indicator for a loading state.
- [table](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/table/README.md): Rows and columns of data.
- [tabs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/tabs/README.md): Tabs that switch between panels, in a row or a column.
- [textarea](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/textarea/README.md): A multi-line text field, for a comment or a description.
- [toggle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/toggle/README.md): A switch for an on/off setting.

## More components

- [breadcrumb](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/breadcrumb/README.md): A trail of links showing where the current page sits in the site hierarchy.
- [calendar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/calendar/README.md): Pick a date, several dates or a range inline: keyboard navigation, disabled dates and bounds, several months, locales, right to left, hidden inputs for forms and a `model` prop for Live Components.
- [chart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/chart/README.md): Charts with Symfony UX Chart.js in the theme's colors, light and dark, each with its data as a table; from arrays or `ChartBuilderInterface`, updated in place by Live Components.
- [data-table](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/data-table/README.md): A server-driven table: search, filters, sortable columns, page size and pages in a Turbo Frame, with Back and Forward through each state. Copies PHP classes into `src/FlowbiteXor/`.
- [data-table-live](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/data-table-live/README.md): `data-table` as a Live Component: search while typing, filters, sorting, pages and row selection for bulk actions, its state in the URL. Copies PHP classes into `src/FlowbiteXor/`.
- [date-picker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/date-picker/README.md): A date or a range picked in a calendar that opens from a button or a typed field; a `DateType` opts in through the form theme.
- [drawer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/drawer/README.md): A panel sliding over one side of the page, for navigation, filters or details, as a native `<dialog>`.
- [empty-state](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/empty-state/README.md): What a list or page shows when it has nothing yet, with a way forward.
- [navbar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/navbar/README.md): The bar on top of the app: brand, search, actions, and the menu button opening the sidebar on small screens.
- [page-header](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/page-header/README.md): The top of a page: its title, a short description and the page's actions.
- [popover](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/popover/README.md): Free content anchored to a button (text, links, a small form) in a non-modal dialog that closes on Escape, a click outside or when the focus leaves it.
- [progress](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/progress/README.md): A bar showing how far a task has come.
- [sidebar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/sidebar/README.md): The app's main navigation: grouped links with icons and counts, collapsible to icons, opened over the page on small screens.
- [stat-card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/stat-card/README.md): A key figure with its label and, optionally, how it changed over a period.
- [toast](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/toast/README.md): Short-lived notifications in a fixed region, added on page load or by Turbo Streams, dismissed after a timeout or by the user.
- [tooltip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/tooltip/README.md): A short text shown while a control is hovered or focused, also announced as its description.

## Forms

- [form-theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/form-theme/README.md): A Symfony form theme that renders every row through `FormField` and every control through the kit's `Input`, `Select`, `Textarea`, `Checkbox`, `Radio`, `Label` and `Button` components.
- [form-field](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/form-field/README.md): A labelled form control with its help text and error message, wired by id (used by the form theme).
- [autocomplete](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/autocomplete/README.md): Searchable selects with Symfony UX Autocomplete (Tom Select), styled with the theme: one choice, several, values typed by the user, options searched on the server. Works through the form theme (`'autocomplete' => true`) and as an `Autocomplete` component outside forms.

## Layouts

- [layouts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/layouts/README.md): Page layouts to extend: an app shell with sidebar and navbar, a centered column for login, signup and password reset, settings, errors and a blank page.

## Blocks

- [dashboard-home](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/dashboard-home/README.md): A dashboard home: page header, key figures, two cards and a table of recent orders.
- [login](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/login/README.md): A sign-in card rendering a Symfony login form through the form theme, with the last authentication error.
- [signup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/signup/README.md): A registration card rendering a Symfony form through the form theme.
- [forgot-password](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/forgot-password/README.md): A card asking for an email address to send a password reset link, then confirming it was sent.
- [settings-profile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/settings-profile/README.md): A profile settings card: avatar, name and a Symfony form rendered through the form theme.
- [not-found](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xormania/flowbite-xor/main/not-found/README.md): The content of a 404 (or any error) page: status, title, explanation and a way back.
